findings.note: VSiN's Game 3 preview doesn't expect Snell to go deep against a patient Brewers lineup that led the league in walk rate and has drawn 11 walks this series; it picks Brewers moneyline and Over 7.5 runs.

Snell made only nine starts in 2026 because of shoulder trouble and elbow surgery, and lasted 3 2/3 innings with five walks in NLDS Game 2, but Roberts says that outing wasn't who Snell is now and expects a different version.

Lists Snell as the likely, not yet confirmed, starter with a 2.19 ERA in five Dodger Stadium starts this year, and notes he threw eight scoreless innings facing the minimum the last time he saw Milwaukee, in the 2025 NLCS; it also mentions his groin-related rust.

VSiN's Adam Burke (Oct 13) priced the Dodgers at -180 and leans Brewers at plus money, saying Milwaukee's league-high walk rate and baserunning are about as tough a matchup as Snell gets; his official pick was Over 7.5 (-106), not a side.

Covers' Quinn Allen picks the Dodgers moneyline in Game 3 (Brewers lead 2-0), backing Snell (1.72 FIP at home) over Gasser, citing Milwaukee's 97 wRC+ vs lefties and LA hitting .312 off Gasser; forecast is clear and 70s.

MLB.com (pre-series) says Ohtani is playing through multiple injuries with a .520 OPS over his past 23 games, and Will Smith went 1-for-16 with 7 strikeouts in the NLDS; its 34 experts split 17-17 on the series.

MLB.com's Game 3 preview leaves Max Muncy out of the projected Dodgers lineup (Kiké Hernández at 3B, Miguel Rojas at 2B), says Ohtani (right biceps, left knee) and Freeman (right knee) are playing through lingering injuries, and notes Snell walked five in his first playoff start.

Covers analyst Quinn Allen picks the Dodgers moneyline for Game 3 (no total pick), pointing to how dominant Snell is at home and against Milwaukee, while saying Gasser has had trouble with the Dodgers lineup; probable starters are Gasser (2.25 ERA) vs Snell (2.46 ERA).

MLB.com's rotation preview notes Gasser has a 5.91 ERA in two career starts against the Dodgers, though it also cites his 1.67 ERA over his last six regular-season outings and high confidence, which cuts against the over.
